Job Description 
 FIS Management Services, LLC seeks Site Reliability Engineer Leads in Jacksonville, FL to maintain, deploy and perform analysis for new UI / Services product offering developed internally. Interface with the
 Development organization, Project Managers, Professional Services, Network, Security, and Server OS support teams. Manage deployment of Unity and surrounding products on new virtual servers. Deploy and maintain Unity in UAT and production, preproduction and test and performance environments. Perform open technical cases with hardware and software vendors to resolve problems. Work with analytical problem-solving skills for complex multi-tiered applications. Apply his ability to trouble shoot through use of wire shark and browser development tools. Utilize broad technology knowledge with automation software. Perform diagnostic work to get to root cause of any issues. Perform disaster recovery testing and planning. Provide feedback to Development on needed improvements on serviceability.
  
 REQUIREMENTS : Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer and Information Science or related field and five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in the job offered or a related occupation: working with SQL Server Database technologies to support tenant database for Decisions workflow and Unity Macrim applications; working with IDP / SSO (Identity Provider/Single Sign-On), WAF (Web Application Firewall) to configure external security for the Unity and UFI applications that are exposed to the internet; working with Windows Server 2016, 2019 and Windows security; utilizing IIS, Apache (reverse proxy) for support of Unity, Global Office, BBGP, UFI applications; working with load balanced applications for Unity, Global Office, BBGP, UFI applications to support high availability.  In the alternative, the employer will accept a Master’s degree in the above listed fields and three (3) years of experience in the above listed skills. Telecommuting and/or working from home may be permissible pursuant to company policies.  
   
 QUALIFIED APPLICANTS:   Please apply directly through our website by clicking on “Apply Now.”
